tool.name: tla2tools
tool.digest: not yet pinned; no lock exists

exit_codes.other: did not complete; counts as neither outcome

bounds: at most three attempts and two changes of target, a limit of two refusals; the history of events is kept in full

cases.purpose: The intended design: the kernel's answers from its records are the ones the history calls for, for an act that claims a high level.
The same for an act that claims the lowest level: the cap must not raise it.
Shopping on one target is reachable.
An agreement on a changed target after a refusal on the old one is reachable: retried, not shopped, and below the limit keeps its grade.
An agreement capped by the limit and not by shopping is reachable.
Planted defect: only the latest attempt counts.
Planted defect: an attempt that was never closed is ignored.
Planted defect: a close names a ticket and the kernel closes the latest open attempt instead.
Planted defect: an attempt is filed under the target as it is when it closes, not when its ticket was taken.
Planted defect: retrying is flagged and the level is not capped.
Planted defect: shopping is not flagged.
Planted defect: only shopping on the same target is capped, and the limit on refusals along the line is ignored: the data model's old rule.
Planted defect: retrying is reported only on the same target, though the cap still follows the whole line; this isolates the flag.
Planted defect: retrying is not reported, though the cap still applies; this isolates the flag.
Planted defect: a change of target forgets the earlier attempts.
Planted defect: the cap sets the level to helper, which raises an act that claimed less.
Planted defect: every agreement after a refusal is capped, even after a change of target and below the limit.
Planted defect: the cap starts one refusal later than the limit says.
